calculation.description: Measures an instrument's location within its trailing 60-session range, centered at zero and scaled by 20-session realized volatility. Positive values identify high-range-location breakouts with lower volatility receiving larger scores. The one-session lag prevents look-ahead bias.

validation.regime_notes: Passed benchmark absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840 at the 20-session horizon on the full available 15-instrument cross-asset panel. Results were especially strong in 2028 (20d IC 0.227027, ICIR 1.12321 over 148 observations), while 2026 was weaker; interpret small-universe estimates conservatively.
